_comment: Where the textbook PDFs and corpus archives come from.
On startup the studio checks whether the data folder holds any textbooks.
If it does not, it works through this list: archives already sitting in the
data folder are unpacked first (nothing is downloaded that you already
have), and only what is still missing is fetched.
Google Drive links must be shared as 'Anyone with the link'.

sources.name: Board-wise Class 10 textbooks (all state boards)
sources.provides: 31 state-board textbook PDFs, English and target languages

sources.name: NCERT chapter PDFs (English and Hindi, classes 10-12)
